claim_ledger.claim_text: Owned Unify Consulting's mandate to turn a governed agentic AI Solution Accelerator into an industrialized enterprise capability, linking control-plane architecture, lifecycle discipline, and alliance distribution to productized services and durable adoption across regulated clients.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:

- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production trust with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, using evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with a production-readiness gate set across intake, validation, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling replayable runtime design and governed exits.
- bul_unify_005: Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data paths, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
